# netskope_device_classification_on_prem_detection (Resource)

DeviceClassificationOnPremDetection Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netskope_device_classification_on_prem_detection" "my_deviceclassificationonpremdetection" {
  config = "{ \"see\": \"documentation\" }"
  name   = "...my_name..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `config` (String) On-prem detection configuration (see onprem_item for example). Parsed as JSON.
- `name` (String) On-prem detection label name

### Read-Only

- `onprem_id` (Number) On-prem detection label ID
- `steering_ids` (List of Number) Steering config IDs associated with this label (computed; managed via steering mapping resource)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = netskope_device_classification_on_prem_detection.my_netskope_device_classification_on_prem_detection
  id = 0
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import netskope_device_classification_on_prem_detection.my_netskope_device_classification_on_prem_detection 0
```
